proposals.evidence: DEDR4422 explicitly gives Tamil piṟa (-nt-) be born and piṟantai birth, alongside Malayalam piṟakka/piṟappu. Ravula Puranda Birth is tentatively compared with the nasal-stop birth formation, preserving the source vowel and voicing spellings. The popular transcription does not demonstrate the initial-vowel correspondence or a precise grammatical form; this is a qualified family proposal, not a source normalization. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.
